claude-sessions joins one assistant message by its id, not by its records sitting together (rich-demos-k78j.mk1)

Claude Code runs a tool while the message that called it is still
streaming, so the call's result, a skill's meta text, or a hidden
goal_status attachment can land between two records of one message.
Joining by adjacency split the message there, and a hidden record split
it only while hidden records were shown. Of the 500 most recent local
transcripts, 14 parsed to a different conversation with H on; none do now.

expectLinearTime takes a larger size itself when the smaller run is under the floor, so a faster runner cannot fail linear work (rich-unfiled-791c.sx9g) (#475)

* expectLinearTime takes a larger size itself when the smaller run is under the floor, so a faster runner cannot fail linear work (rich-unfiled-791c.sx9g)

* expectLinearTime returns the size it measured at, so its own stall tests fail rather than pass vacuously when a faster runner grows the size (rich-unfiled-791c.sx9g)

The unmeasurable message says to pass a larger size again: linear work given
a size more than 64 times too small fails with it too. The escalation tests
pin the sizes tried to the x4 sequence.
